title: Brand Pages
description:
## Brand Overview Page

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** shopper looking to browse products by brand, **I want** to view all available brands grouped alphabetically, **so that** I can quickly find a specific brand and explore its product offerings.

---

[Basic Page Template](https://www.figma.com/design/iOpGWO38HkhnTYkEeEq8Oz/Laioutr-Basic?node-id=84-42271&t=WsyhlVHQyGVajZ9T-4) | [AMBIENDO Page Template](https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=167-39722&t=dGCF5bfCHeD4Bepj-4)

| Alphabetical Grouping Brands are listed A–Z, grouped under corresponding letter headings. Non-alphabetic characters (e.g., numbers, symbols) are grouped and positioned before A–Z | [mobile brand list](https://www.figma.com/design/fU79c88OUWKPwScoPQ0Yag/laioutr-CMS?node-id=276-97391&t=2FpqZago9DvoDz6H-4) [desktop brand list](https://www.figma.com/design/fU79c88OUWKPwScoPQ0Yag/laioutr-CMS?node-id=276-113560&t=2FpqZago9DvoDz6H-4)  
 ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=9dd85a6e-1596-41e5-9178-d17c2389bad7&&collection=&height=544&occurrenceKey=null&width=420&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) |
| --- | --- |
| Link Behavior Each brand name is a link to its individual brand detail/product page. Links open in the same tab unless configured otherwise. [Use internal brand list link with amount pill](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=20214-5383&t=trMEQiF1AD9o3Leb-4) | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=2c8b36e4-c54f-41ed-b54f-7cc04e7d0508&&collection=&height=480&occurrenceKey=null&width=360&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| **Layout** has optional

section under the title (Logo Slider) has content slot after brand list  | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=eb19dcee-2f25-4a67-8d01-4d664c2a9149&&collection=&height=317&occurrenceKey=null&width=246&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) if the top brands section is hidden, hide the separator under it too (so that no two separators can be seen directly one after the other)  |
| **SEO** URL Structure URL: `/brands/` (canonical) Brand page links should follow a clean, SEO-friendly format HTML Markup Use semantic HTML (`<section>`, `<h2>`, `<ul>`, `<li>`, `<a>`) for brand groupings. Use meaningful heading structure: `h1` for the page title, `h2` for alphabet letters, `h3` optional under each section. Internal Linking All brand links should be crawlable by search engines (no JavaScript-only rendering). Ensure each brand has a dedicated page linked from this overview. Meta Tags Custom `<title>` and `<meta description>` for `/brands/` page. Structured data (e.g., `ItemList` schema) can be added to improve search engine understanding. |  |
| **Accessibility**  Semantic HTML Use correct ARIA roles (e.g., `role="navigation"` for the letter index). Use `<nav aria-label="Brand alphabet navigation">` for the A–Z index. Keyboard Navigation All links must be accessible via keyboard (tab and enter). Skip link provided to bypass navigation and jump to main content. Screen Reader Support Letter groupings should be announced properly (e.g., "Section A – Brands starting with A").  |  |
| **Non-Functional Requirements** **Performance**: Fast loading using pagination or lazy loading if there are hundreds of brands. **Scalability**: Can support hundreds of brands without degrading performance. **Accessibility**: Meet WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. **SEO**: Structured, crawlable HTML and keyword-optimized copy. |  |

## Brand Page

### <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As** a shopper interested in a specific brand, **I want** to visit a dedicated brand page that shows all products from that brand, **so that** I can easily explore and purchase items only from the brand I trust or prefer.

---

[Basic Page Template](https://www.figma.com/design/iOpGWO38HkhnTYkEeEq8Oz/Laioutr-Basic?node-id=89-298202&t=WsyhlVHQyGVajZ9T-4) | [AMBIENDO Page Template](https://www.figma.com/design/gDN7wlDFp5mwXQfRDhotzR/Ambiendo---sunny?node-id=176-91126&t=ILbTDINjUqk3ekCU-4)

The Brand Page will be a dedicated landing page for each brand available on the platform. It should display all associated products, allow filtering and sorting, feature relevant SEO content for search engines, and offer a way to explore other brands.

| **Brand Header** Brand logo (if available) Brand name Short brand description (optional) Background image with black or white overlay (optional)  only show overlay when the user adds a background image has 3 background image styles/variants: light image dark image plain (aka no image) use [placeholder image svgs](https://www.figma.com/design/Zle03g3Z7ieN700SDq5j77/Component-Examples?node-id=1321-379646&t=zXwA6JoVu4dYHZte-4) for the different variants | [Design examples](https://www.figma.com/design/Zle03g3Z7ieN700SDq5j77/Component-Examples?node-id=1321-379624) [laioutr CMS component](https://www.figma.com/design/fU79c88OUWKPwScoPQ0Yag/laioutr-CMS?node-id=289-110320&t=67PEL5DWpbtQtnpO-4) ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=3bf52b42-e718-451c-928e-41925f267f4c&&collection=&height=684&occurrenceKey=null&width=249&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=17d7fe0d-7efd-4035-a232-71a67d4ad44b&&collection=&height=491&occurrenceKey=null&width=233&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| --- | --- |
| **Products** display filter bar list all products of that brand as grid show **load more** if the number of products is more than the specified load more limit | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=72b2c734-b2dd-4ae4-988d-9557770dfcbf&&collection=&height=540&occurrenceKey=null&width=701&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| **SEO Content Section** Editable CMS content can also simply be HTML / richtext if the user does not want to use blocks Positioned below the product list Contains keyword-optimized brand-related information (e.g.,

) | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=13684f2e-f57a-443f-bb10-cd3b42e0a91e&&collection=&height=1020&occurrenceKey=null&width=711&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| **Brand grid** display brand grid  | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=ed965054-01dd-443c-8dfd-5346526945e5&&collection=&height=456&occurrenceKey=null&width=712&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)  |
| **URL Structure** SEO-friendly: `/brands/{brand-name}/` Canonical URL to prevent duplication OpenGraph and meta tags per brand |  |
| **CMS Integration** Admins must be able to: Add/edit SEO content Add brand logos and metadata Associate products with brands Reorder filter options (if needed) |  |
| **Accessibility** WCAG 2.1 AA compliant Keyboard navigation ARIA labels for interactive elements |  |
| **Analytics and Tracking** <custom data-type="status" data-id="id-2">nice to have</custom>  Track visits to each brand page Track filter/sort usage Product impressions and clicks SEO text interaction (scroll depth, link clicks) |  |

enrichedData.purpose: Enables shoppers to browse and discover products organized by brand through a dedicated brand overview page with alphabetical grouping and individual brand landing pages with product listings, filters, and SEO content.
useCases: Display all brands grouped alphabetically with A-Z letter headings
Link each brand name to its dedicated brand detail page
Show optional 'Top brands' section with logo slider
Display brand header with logo, name, description, and customizable background image
List all products from a brand in a filterable and sortable grid
Show 'load more' button for paginated product results
Display editable SEO content section below product listings
Show brand grid for cross-brand exploration
Provide keyboard navigation and screen reader support for accessibility
